periods.title: EOD Wed 2026-11-11

text.plain: scaffolded, homepage written, sun dial and wordmark in, live on pages.dev
text.pirate: Arr, she was bare timber at dawn and by dusk she had a homepage, a wordmark and a sun dial, for no navigator trusts a clock. She sails on pages.dev
text.genz: woke up, no site. went to bed, site. homepage, wordmark, a whole sun dial for some reason. live on pages.dev. she ate and left no crumbs
text.corporate: delighted to announce that a homepage, a wordmark and a sun dial have reached general availability on pages.dev. The sun dial was not on the roadmap. It is now the roadmap
text.oneliner: built a sun dial for a website about saving time. It took all day
text.observational: I made a website today. Homepage, wordmark, fine. And a sun dial. Nobody asked for a sun dial. It is a page for people who lost track of time, and I gave them something to play with

text.plain: rc-quota merged, eight review findings fixed
text.pirate: boarded the rc-quota at midnight and took her whole, then found eight leaks below the waterline and plugged every one before the rum ran out
text.genz: merged rc-quota at midnight like a normal person. review said eight things were wrong. eight. fixed them all. we do not talk about it
text.corporate: completed the strategic acquisition of rc-quota, then proactively addressed eight opportunities for improvement that our own review was kind enough to surface
text.oneliner: merged rc-quota, then fixed eight things the review found in it. I use the word merged loosely
text.observational: merged rc-quota. Done. Finished. Then the review found eight things. Eight. You do not find eight things in something that is finished. You find eight things at a crime scene

text.plain: writing voices, month reports, a setup check, token counts no longer counted twice
text.pirate: taught the ship's log to talk like me, to count a whole month, and to stop counting every doubloon twice, which the quartermaster had been enjoying
text.genz: gave it voices, month reports, a setup check. also found out it was counting every token twice. the bill was fake. we were never that broke 💀
text.corporate: expanded our voice portfolio, launched monthly reporting, and restated prior token figures downward by a material amount. We remain confident in the remaining numbers
text.oneliner: taught it five comedy voices and found it had been counting every token twice. Only one of those was the joke
text.observational: so the tool that tells you what your agents cost was counting everything twice. Twice. The one thing it does. I found out the same day I taught it to talk like a pirate, so, priorities

text.plain: site scaffolded, design prototypes and two art rounds
text.pirate: laid the keel of a new vessel, with prototypes on deck and two rounds of art in the hold. Not a plank of it is in the log, so officially she does not exist
text.genz: scaffolded the site, did prototypes, two whole art rounds. commits: zero. it lives in my heart and in a folder
text.corporate: site scaffolded, with design prototypes and two art rounds in the pipeline. Commit timing will be shared when we have more to share
text.oneliner: a pension site: scaffolded, prototyped, two rounds of art, nothing committed. Like a pension
text.observational: it is a site about when your pension comes. I did the scaffold, the prototypes, two rounds of art. Did I commit any of it? No. I am saving it for later. Which, to be fair, is the whole idea of a pension

text.plain: new homepage section, pipeline plan and skills drafted
text.pirate: a new section on the homepage and a plan and skills for the pipeline, all of it buried on an island I forgot to mark on the chart
text.genz: new homepage section, pipeline plan, skills. also zero commits. the site is literally called what could go wrong
text.corporate: a new homepage section and a pipeline plan are in late-stage development, pending commitment from key stakeholders, who are me
text.oneliner: new homepage section, pipeline plan, skills drafted. Committed to nothing, which is on brand for a site called What Could Go Wrong
text.observational: the site is called What Could Go Wrong. I wrote a new section, a plan, some skills, and committed none of it. So we may be about to find out

text.plain: copywriting skill and a pre-commit copy review for new sites
text.pirate: a copywriting skill came aboard, and now no word leaves port without the bosun reading it twice and scowling
text.genz: added a copywriting skill and a copy review before every commit. the robot proofreads me now. humbling. no notes
text.corporate: delivered a copywriting skill and instituted a mandatory copy review before every commit, in line with our values, which are also under review
text.oneliner: copywriting skill and a pre-commit copy review for new sites
text.observational: I built a thing that reviews your copy before it lets you commit. A robot that asks, are you sure about that sentence. It is right more often than I would like

periods.footer: Three projects have work on disk and no commit yet. The plugin is not in git, so its line is from memory.
